whatLeoChecks.title: What Leo pays attention to before you spend a Saturday on a viewing

categories.name: City & access
categories.description: Real transport isochrones for transit, bike, and walking
items: Distance to your work or campus
How you'd actually get there (walking, transit, bike)
Connection to places you go most often — gym, friends, sports, nightlife

categories.name: Street & building
items: Traffic and street noise
Nearby bars and terraces
General feel of the block and entrance
Floor level and lift vs stairs

categories.name: Look & feel
categories.description: AI visual analysis of listing photos
items: Likely natural light in the main rooms
Whether the layout feels open or fragmented
Signs of staging vs actual lived-in space
Overall vibe from listing photos

categories.name: Age & structure
items: Building year and construction type from cadastro
Known issues for buildings of that era (aluminosis, asbestos)
ITE status and recent inspections
Community complaints and neighbourhood reputation

whatLeoChecks.callout: You don't have to guess from thumbnails. Leo reads the data, the photos, and the context to decide what's worth your time.

viewingDay.title: On viewing day, you focus on how it feels. Leo learns from what you notice.
viewingDay.description: When you go see a place, your job is simple: notice how it feels to be there.
viewingDay.afterViewing: After the viewing, you send Leo:
bullets: a quick rating on how much it felt like "home"
some notes on what you liked or didn't (light, noise, layout, area)
any photos you took that show the reality
viewingDay.detail: Leo uses all this to adjust what he recommends next, so each round of places feels closer to what you actually want, not what you thought you wanted on paper.

movingProfile.title: One profile that follows you between flats
movingProfile.description: Most portals forget you the moment you sign a lease. Leo does the opposite.
movingProfile.detail: Every move teaches Leo more about how you live:
bullets: which kinds of streets actually suit you
which layouts you keep rejecting
where you're willing to compromise
actions: **start a search** when you're thinking of moving
**reactivate** next time life changes and you're ready to move again
movingProfile.callout: Whether it's your second rental or your seventh, you don't have to explain yourself from scratch.
movingProfile.pauseDescription: Leo's keeping your preferences warm until you're ready.

whatLeoLooksInto.title: What Leo considers before you walk into a potential home

categories.name: The building and its history
items: Approximate year and construction type
Clues from official records about size and use
Signs that future works might be coming

categories.name: The flat itself
items: Likely light in the main rooms
Relationship between rooms (flow, usability, privacy)
Floor level and trade-offs (noise vs stairs vs lift)

categories.name: The surroundings
items: Daily access to work, school, or key places in your life
Street character and likely noise patterns
General feel of the immediate area

categories.name: Your plans
items: Whether the place seems to fit "as is" or might need changes
Whether the layout seems friendly to typical renovations
How the home might feel for you in a few years, not just move-in day

whatLeoLooksInto.callout: The goal isn't to replace professionals or official checks — it's to help you focus your energy on a smaller set of homes that are actually worth digging into.

viewingChecklist.title: What you walk in with when you use Leo
viewingChecklist.description: For each home you're seriously considering, Leo prepares a checklist structured around:
bullets: **What to look at** in each key room
**What to pay attention to** in the building and street
**What to ask** the agent or owner
**What to note down** for comparing later
reflects: the type of risks most common in that kind of building or area
your tolerance for work and change
viewingChecklist.detail: You can open it on your phone during the viewing and check things off as you go, adding your own notes and photos.

afterViewing.title: After the viewing, Leo helps you compare and decide
afterViewing.description: Once you've seen a place, you can:
bullets: log whether it felt like a serious contender
note what you liked and what bothered you
attach photos showing important details
leoActions: updates how he scores future homes
helps you compare candidates on the things that matter to you
highlights patterns emerging in what you keep accepting or rejecting
afterViewing.detail: Over time, the homes you're shown align more with the reality of your choices, not just your initial description.

renovationHelp.title: When a place "almost" works, Leo can help you explore options
renovationHelp.description: If you're open to doing some work, you can ask Leo to sketch out a few renovation paths, like:
paths: a minimal refresh to make it liveable
a comfort upgrade to match your lifestyle
a more transformative project if the structure allows
leoSketches: what would change in the space
how it might affect the way you use the home
a rough idea of cost and complexity
renovationHelp.callout: This doesn't replace architects or contractors — it gives you a clearer starting point to discuss with them.
